name: tabbed-dashboard
description: Tabbed Dashboard — Full-width underline tabs (with icons + sublabels) split the page into two distinct workspaces. Overview tab: KPI-led (4 KPI cards + trend line + breakdown donut). Detail tab: table-led with search, status filter chips, Export action, a 14-row item table, and a breakdown table. Use when at-a-glance summary and deep-dive workflows should each get their own view.
